_about: NAP listing sites checked every run (rule 8, v15.2). group: network = CLIKsearch syndicates to it (deck 'CLIKsearch_Mitsubishi_GBP_Managed_Service_Program_NO_Video_v.07.13.26', pages 17-18); ai = AI tools, search engines or car shoppers read it; both = both. method: headless = engine/listing_scan.py searches it signed out; chrome = read in the user's signed-in Chrome (the site blocks automated browsers); site_search = no search box, find the listing with a web search 'site:<domain> <dealer> <city>'; upstream = not public, fed by the sites in covered_by (checked there); down = unreachable when checked; skip = not checked: no public lookup, a login or bot wall, no result for a real dealer, or the same data as a site that is checked (see why). A site that cannot be read is never retried: record it and move on. cited_only = checked only when the AI answer check cites it. Placeholders: {name} {city} {st} {zip} {phone} {brand}. checked: the date the method was last confirmed.
